title: Car Color Jam
description: Untangle a packed parking lot of color-coded cars and buses—send each vehicle out in the right order to pick up matching passengers before the waiting bays fill up.
controls: Tap unblocked colored cars to drive them into the boarding bays and pick up matching-color passengers from the queue.

zh-CN.title: 看谁能通关
zh-CN.description: 爆火全网的挪车接人颜色排序！精准判断出车顺序，把堵满停车场的彩色小车开进候车位，接走对应颜色乘客清空全场。
zh-CN.controls: 点击前方无阻挡的彩色车辆驶入候车位，自动接走同色乘客；合理规划空位避免卡死，接完所有乘客即可通关。
